vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2023-0071
vulnerability.description: Marvin Attack: potential key recovery through timing sidechannels

statements.impact_statement: Springtale serves vulnerable populations under active surveillance. Any pulled-in `rsa` would be a supply-chain CVE waiting to land. The crate is banned at the workspace level via `deny.toml` `[bans].deny` so any transitive pull fails CI before merge.
statements.action_statement: Enforced by `cargo deny check bans` in `.github/workflows/sca.yml`. Re-evaluate if upstream releases a patched version with constant-time operations.
